purpose: Big-data pretrip standard-metered NYC yellow-taxi base fare_amount USD with pinned Taxi Zone centroid Haversine distance and minute-resolution cyclic local time; not a final bill or quote guarantee.

feature_derivation.hour: Minute-resolution NYC local time (hour + minute / 60.0) in [0, 24); sin/cos with period 24.
feature_derivation.day_of_week: Monday=0..Sunday=6 in NYC local time; sin/cos with period 7.
feature_derivation.weekend: Saturday or Sunday in NYC local time (1.0 or 0.0).
feature_derivation.holiday: Membership in the checksum-pinned nationwide observed OPM calendar (1.0 or 0.0).
feature_derivation.zone_centroid_distance_km: Great-circle Haversine distance in kilometers (R=6371.0088 km) between area-weighted planar polygon centroids of pickup_location_id and dropoff_location_id from checksum-pinned assets/taxi_zones/taxi_zones.geojson (0.0 when pickup_location_id == dropoff_location_id).
feature_derivation.zones: String categories from integer named TLC LocationID domain 1..263, indexed via train-only StringIndexer(handleInvalid='keep') with maxBins=264 to accommodate up to 263 seen zones plus 1 unknown bucket.
feature_derivation.unknown_category: A valid zone unseen during train remains its string value for the fitted __unknown bucket. Invalid/unknown TLC IDs 264/265 are rejected.

calendar.missing_coverage: reject; never implicitly set future unknown dates to non-holiday

time_policy.now: Freeze an aware UTC submit instant, convert to America/New_York once at submit, store UUID/offset/fold/calendar/geometry/tzdb identity; rerun reuses the snapshot.
time_policy.serving: Offset-aware local ISO timestamp plus America/New_York; offset must agree with the zone, ambiguous local time requires fold 0/1, nonexistent local time is rejected.
time_policy.historical: TLC NTZ stays NYC local wall time without inventing an instant or DST fold; repeated fall hour preserves wall features; nonexistent spring hour is rejected.
time_policy.tzdb_artifact_requirement: A fitted artifact must pin the actual America/New_York TZif SHA256 reported by timezone_identity(), plus provider/package version where available.

request_policy: Exact required snapshot fields; missing fields and unknown extras fail, including recorded trip_distance. Callers must provide pinned contract, calendar, geometry and tzdb identities.
v22_policy: No change to frozen V1 or V2.2 helpers, contracts, bundles or serving endpoints. V2.3 lives in separate modules and contract files.

cohort_policy.boundaries: Half-open by actual pickup NYC local datetime, not source month.
cohort_policy.holdout_policy: Preparation/counts/overlap only; do not fit preprocessing or tune on holdout, and do not evaluate until the candidate/cohort/features/gates are locked.
